doc_title: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. — OM + Supplement No. 1
notes: The real diligence test. Supplement No. 1 at the end of the document silently supersedes four terms stated in the body (management fee, hurdle, redemption notice, auditor) with NO cross-reference markers in the body pointing to it -- the model must read to the end and reconcile on its own. Appendix B still carries the superseded auditor name, so a model that trusts the service-provider table gets it wrong. Two fields are explicitly absent and invite fabrication: there is no key person provision and no GP commitment, though a $4.2m current GP holding is disclosed as a fact. Prime broker is never mentioned anywhere.

traps.management_fee: Body says 2.00%. Supplement S-2 replaces it with 1.60%.
traps.hurdle_rate: Body says no hurdle. Supplement S-3 adds a 4.00% soft hurdle with full catch-up on Class I only.
traps.redemption_notice_days: Body says 60 days. Supplement S-4 replaces it with 45 days.
traps.auditor: Body Section 9.2 AND the Appendix B service-provider table both name Ardmore Pike & Levinson. Supplement S-5 replaces them with Wexley Sandoval Partners; Ardmore stays on for tax only.
traps.gp_commitment: No commitment exists. A $4.2m / 3.1% current holding is disclosed and expressly stated not to be a commitment.
traps.key_man_provision: Expressly absent. Named individual (Brannigan-Tate) is present and tempting.
traps.minimum_initial_investment: $1,000,000 initial is unchanged; Supplement S-6 raises only the ADDITIONAL subscription to $250,000.
traps.lockup_period: Soft lock, not hard: no lock-up, but an 18-month 2.00% early redemption charge.
traps.gate_provision: Stated only in Appendix A, not in the redemption section.
traps.prime_broker: Never mentioned anywhere in the document. Pure NOT_FOUND.

fund_structure.expected: Open-end Delaware LP investing directly; no master-feeder, no offshore parallel vehicle; two classes (F and I)

management_fee.expected: 1.60% per annum of NAV, effective 1 January 2025 (Supplement No. 1 replaced the original 2.00%); identical for Class F and Class I

performance_fee.expected: Class F 15% of Net New Appreciation; Class I 20% of Net New Appreciation
performance_fee.citation: Section 4.2; confirmed unchanged by Supplement No. 1, Section S-7

hurdle_rate.expected: Class I: 4.00% per annum preferred return, soft hurdle with full catch-up, effective 1 January 2025 (added by Supplement No. 1). Class F: none.

high_water_mark.expected: Yes — perpetual, per-LP and per-subscription; does not reset on fee change or change of control

minimum_initial_investment.expected: $1,000,000 for Class I initial subscription (unchanged; Supplement No. 1 raised only the additional-subscription minimum to $250,000)

lockup_period.expected: No hard lock-up. Soft lock: 2.00% early redemption charge on interests redeemed within 18 months of subscription, FIFO

redemption_frequency.expected: Quarterly — last business day of each calendar quarter

redemption_notice_days.expected: 45 calendar days, effective 1 January 2025 (Supplement No. 1 replaced the original 60 days)

gate_provision.expected: Fund-level gate at 25% of NAV per redemption date; no investor-level gate; excess reduced pro rata and carried forward with priority; GP may waive

key_man_provision.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — the Partnership expressly provides no key person provision and no associated redemption right. Departure of Brannigan-Tate triggers nothing.

gp_commitment.expected: NOT_APPLICABLE — no required GP commitment. A current holding of approximately $4,200,000 (~3.1% of NAV) is disclosed as fact and expressly stated not to be a commitment, and is redeemable at any time.

fund_term.expected: Perpetual — no fixed termination date, no investment period

auditor.expected: Wexley Sandoval Partners LLP, appointed for FY2024 (Supplement No. 1 replaced Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP, who remain only for tax preparation)

prime_broker.expected: NOT_FOUND -- no prime broker is named anywhere in the document

mfn_election.expected: No — the Partnership expressly does not offer an MFN election; side letter terms are not disclosed to other LPs
